text: Completed event/support coherence audit. Replaced inferred Event.Saccade construction with ScanpathTransition, a separate non-event type that honestly permits zero-duration abutting boundaries; MultiMatch now consumes transitions and a compile-time court proves they cannot inhabit Event.Saccade. EventSeries.of now proves an event lies within the recording, derives the exact range selected by its timestamps, rejects mismatches, and reconstructs fixation centre, usable sample count, and method-specific dispersion from source samples while preserving Recomputed warp evidence. EventSeries.supported, SampleSupportLedger.get, SampleLabels.get, and AoiAssignment.get are total Option APIs; AOI smallest-containing preparation no longer uses Grid/Map .get, and internal detection range assembly returns typed failure rather than partial construction. Mutation evidence killed stale-centre reuse, range-check bypass, partial EventSeries/ledger/labels/AOI accessors, and empty-span event validation. Final matrix: core 74/74 JVM+JS, detect 68/68 JVM+JS, AOI 10/10 JVM+JS, compare 106/106 JVM+JS, IO 19/19 JVM+JS, laws 225/225 JVM and 222/222 JS. scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck, checkBoundaries, headerCheckAll, and git diff --check pass. Host disk pressure interrupted one lawsJS compile; only explicitly enumerated ignored sbt targets/test bundles were removed, all source and Mote data were preserved, and lawsJS then passed. No staging, commit, or push performed.
